review.intent_summary: Check caller-declared numerical limits, including before calibration, while distinguishing exact violations from statistical anomalies and policy-authorized actions.

criteria.criterion: Values outside an inclusive acceptable range are violations, while values on the boundary are accepted.
Absolute and relative changes must exceed their declared maximum to violate a rule.
Relative-change checks require a nonzero previous value and do not bridge missing observations.
Violations identify the exact declared rule and remain action-ineligible unless policy explicitly permits them.

verification_evidence: Ran .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m anomalyzer analyze examples/agentic/unit-cost.json and manually confirmed that output names review-above-13c and its declared [0, 0.13] bound, reports detection readiness as not_assessed, and leaves cause and business impact unresolved.
